editorialConventions: In Chapter 13, Arjuna's opening inquiry ('prakṛtiṁ puruṣaṁ caiva...'), which is omitted or unnumbered in Shankara and Ramanuja recensions to achieve exactly 700 verses, is preserved as Chapter 13 prologue invocation metadata, with verses 1..34 mapping faithfully to Sri Bhagavanuvacha onward.
Word-by-word meanings provided for every verse.
Roman transliteration provided for every verse.
Audio recitation links mapped for every verse to high-fidelity MP3 recitations from the gita/gita open archive.
